notes.type_correctness: PauseModal constructor signature (stage: Container), public API (show/hide/setSelection/getSelection/resize/onSelect), and all internal types are correct. BlurFilter import and Filter type import match PixiJS v8 patterns. TypeScript compilation clean.
notes.pattern_adherence: Two intentional deviations from spec: (1) blur tracks 5 containers (board/piece/effects/uiContainer/touchContainer) vs spec's 3 — correct enhancement that blurs HUD and touch controls. (2) ArrowUp/Down in pause key listener uses modular wrap-around instead of Math.min/max clamping — better UX for a 2-option menu. (3) removePauseKeyListener?.() replaced with explicit null check pattern — minor style deviation, functionally identical.
notes.test_coverage: 17 PauseModal tests covering: construction (hidden by default), show/hide idempotency, selection state, onSelect callback for both options, resize safety, and visual prefix state. All 10 spec-required test cases implemented plus 7 additional edge cases.
notes.security: No network I/O. Keyboard event handler uses e.code (not e.key) — correct, layout-independent. e.preventDefault() called for ArrowUp/Down/Enter — prevents scroll artifacts. No untrusted input processed.
notes.architectural_alignment: modalContainer is last addChild on app.stage — correct render order above all game layers. PauseModal imports only from pixi.js — ui-layer boundary respected. resumeFromPause() dispatches GameAction.Pause through updateGameState rather than mutating state directly — correct engine API usage. prevPhase edge detection prevents double-blur/modal on rapid transitions.
